Thanks again for the productive demo last week. Per our discussion, we'd like to formally kick off a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we can align on milestones, owners, and a realistic close timeline. I attached a first-pass MAP (Novus-MAP-v1.xlsx) with proposed milestones below.

- Proposed high-level timeline: discovery -> eval -> procurement -> decision:

  - Eval environment live & first-run: 2026-12-02
  - Procurement kickoff: 2026-12-10
  - Decision / PO targeted: 2026-12-17
- Key success metrics to include on the MAP: time-to-production, model accuracy on your evaluation prompts, and projected unit cost per 1k tokens.
- Please review the attached MAP and the short checklist (MutualActionPlan-Checklist.docx). If that looks good, suggest a 30-min MAP kickoff call — I can host next week.

I've cc'd Marissa (AE) who will coordinate onboarding, and Rishi (VP Sales) who will be our escalation point for enterprise SLAs. Laura from solutions is on the thread for technical materials.

Attachments: Novus-MAP-v1.xlsx, MutualActionPlan-Checklist.docx
